items.title: Solana transactions just got more than 3 times bigger, giving an edge over Ethereum
items.snippet: Transaction V1 raises Solana’s limit to 4,096 bytes from 1,232, giving developers more room for multi-step trades, company-wallet approvals and privacy proofs.
items.note: Позитивний тон для ETH, SOL за ключовими словами.

items.title: CoinEx to cease operation after 9 years, citing ‘significant’ crypto contraction
items.snippet: CoinEx said falling trading volumes and liquidity, along with rising regulatory and compliance costs, had exceeded “reasonable boundaries,” with withdrawals remaining open until Dec. 22.

items.title: U.S. House panel shares crypto tax bill ahead of hearing later this week
items.snippet: The House Ways and Means Committee published a crypto tax bill addressing de minimis transactions, staking and other issues for which the industry's clamored for policies.
